result.title: Satellite detections and incident identity
result.text: NASA FIRMS detections are satellite thermal anomalies, not a count of distinct fires. A single fire may generate many detections over different sensors and days. Thermal anomalies can also be agricultural burning or industrial sources. A selected polygon or H3 hexagon is a query area, not a confirmed wildfire perimeter.
